purpose: Whether any authorized target exists that could judge a change to each parameter. A data question, asked before any sensitivity question.

supportClasses.HISTORICAL_NUMERIC_SUPPORT: An authorized numeric historical target exists and is populated.
supportClasses.HISTORICAL_QUALITATIVE_SUPPORT: Only documented qualitative identity exists — direction, not magnitude.
supportClasses.SYNTHETIC_CONTROL_SUPPORT: No historical target, but a controlled synthetic comparison can bound it.
supportClasses.STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION_ONLY: Can only be checked for structural sanity (invariants, monotonicity), not fitted.
supportClasses.UNSUPPORTED: Moves the engine, but nothing authorized can judge which direction is better.

corpusEvidence.eraEnvironmentNote: src/v3/data/eras.js records its environment values as sourced from 'Basketball Reference league index'. Under the standing source policy those values cannot be used as calibration targets. This is pre-existing production data and was not introduced by Phase 6C2C2.

fixedNotCalibratable.value: shot clock, backcourt count, three-point distance
fixedNotCalibratable.why: Rules of the era. Facts, not judgements.
Arithmetic. AST <= FGM is not a coefficient.
Historical rules. Era gating is authoritative.

parameters.reason: Judged against Tier C player-share targets (132 share maps across 30 fixtures) plus synthetic guardrails. Distributional support, not team efficiency.
